note: Written 2026-09-27 BEFORE any ICO data was parsed or any guidance/enforcement retrieval code existed. Same split rule as cases.json: odd ids = dev (tuning allowed), even ids = held-out (reported only). Plain-English questions (33-44) avoid the law's own wording on purpose -- they test whether ICO guidance bridges the vocabulary gap; 'expect' = law provisions a correct answer should cite (same matching rule as cases.json). Enforcement questions (45-52) have factual answers: 'truth' is derived from the fetched data by eval/derive_ico_truth.py (independent SQL, not the retrieval code) and fixed before retrieval runs on them.
